datasets.title: NSE - Nifty 50 Index Minute data (2015 to 2026)
datasets.date_range: 2015-01-09 .. 2026-05-18 (2810 session dates in the 5m file; 2616 usable after >=13-bar filter)

observability.volume: UNOBSERVABLE (column present but all 0 -- NSE cash index has no volume)
observability.timestamp_resolution: 1 minute / 5 minute; naive local timestamps = IST (NSE 09:15 open confirmed)

datasets.suitability: A - DIRECTLY USEFUL FOR H1/H7 VALIDATION
datasets.license: not declared on Kaggle API metadata; local research use only, not redistributed
known_limitations: Cash INDEX, not the NIFTY FUTURE. The H1/H7 engine is volume-free and the frozen research treats NIFTY as INDEX bars when futures volume is absent, so this is schema/semantics compatible -- but it is spot, not the traded futures contract.
volume column is all zeros; OI absent.
143 / 209888 bars fall outside 09:15-15:30 (0.07%) -- filtered out by the adapter.
min 9 bars on some holiday-truncated sessions -- the engine's own >=(START+FWD+1) guard drops them.
License not declared via the Kaggle API metadata stub; used locally for research evaluation only, NOT redistributed.

datasets.title: NiftyFutures Tick by Tick level 5 Depth Data

observability.OHLC: partial (session-running bar repeated per row, not per-tick OHLC)
observability.tick: OBSERVABLE-ish (1-second LTP snapshots, not true tick-by-tick trades)
observability.L2_depth: OBSERVABLE (bid/ask levels 1-5, price+qty+orders each) -- BUT header-to-data alignment is questionable; the first 'bid' triple looks like prev-close/day-hi/day-lo, real ladder starts at level 2. Needs manual schema repair before use.
observability.trade_side_aggressor: UNOBSERVABLE (no trade-side / aggressor / tick-direction column; totalbuyqty / totalsellqty are day-cumulative PENDING order-book quantities, not executed aggressor volume)

datasets.suitability: B (sample only) - genuine 5-level bid/ask depth for ONE session; NOT validation-grade; column alignment needs manual reverse-engineering; aggressor absent

known_limitations: ONE session only -> cannot validate anything; a code-development sample at best.
1-second SNAPSHOTS, not an order-book event stream (no individual add/cancel between snaps).
NO aggressor / trade-side -> delta, absorption, footprint, iceberg remain UNOBSERVABLE.
